Package com.smu.mysql

Interface PendingCertDao

public interface PendingCertDao
DAO for the pending_certs queue table (see sql/pending_certs.sql). Written to by an external program; consumed here by MTC_BuildRunner.

fetchPendingBatch(int) uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED so that a batch it selects is locked for the remainder of the enclosing transaction — safe to run concurrently with the writer program, and safe against two overlapping runner invocations picking up the same rows.

  • Method Details

    • fetchPendingBatch

      List<PendingCertRow> fetchPendingBatch(int limit)
      Locks and returns up to limit not-yet-processed ADD rows, oldest first. Must be called from within a transaction (see MTC_Data_Dao#inTransaction); the lock is held until that transaction commits or rolls back.
      Parameters:
      limit - maximum number of rows to fetch.
      Returns:
      the locked rows, oldest (id ascending) first.

    • markProcessed

      void markProcessed(List<Long> ids, long processedTime)
      Marks the given rows as processed. Must be called in the same transaction as the corresponding fetchPendingBatch(int) (and the resulting MTC_Service.build() call), so the marking commits atomically with the Merkle tree writes it corresponds to.
      Parameters:
      ids - the pending_certs.id values to mark.
      processedTime - the epoch millisecond time to record as processed_time.
